name: save_user_config
description: Update a user preference. Use dot-notation for nested keys, e.g. 'fab_constraints.fab_house'. Call this when the user says things like 'always use JLCPCB' or 'I prefer 0402 passives'.

key_path.description: Dot-notation path to the config key, e.g. 'fab_constraints.fab_house' or 'default_passives.decoupling_cap'

value.description: New value to set (string, number, array, or object)
